sources.title: Public Holidays Act, Cap. P40, Laws of the Federation of Nigeria 2004 (Policy and Legal Advocacy Centre’s Laws of Nigeria; interior.gov.ng answers 503, 2026-10-27)
sources.said: The days mentioned in the Schedule to this Act shall be kept as public holidays throughout Nigeria. ... 5. ... (b) if any day appointed to be a public holiday falls on a Saturday or a Sunday, only the Saturday or Sunday concerned and no other day in lieu of either of such days shall be kept as a public holiday ... SCHEDULE New Year's Day Good Friday Easter Monday Workers' Day (1st May) Democracy Day (29th May) National Day (1st October) Christmas Day Such day as the Minister may declare to be a public holiday in celebration of the Muslim festival of Id el Fitr ... of Id el Kabir ... in celebration of the birthday of the Prophet Muhammed (Id el Maulud)
